meta.summary: A desktop app to import games from other launchers into Steam.

steamUser.title: Pick your Steam user
steamUser.description: Scan your installed launchers and pick which Steam user to import into, right when you open the app.

games.title: Choose which games to import
games.description: Every detected game from Epic, GOG, itch.io, and more is listed with a toggle, or add any executable manually as a custom non-Steam game.

artwork.title: Review matched grid images, heroes, and logos
artwork.description: Full Steam Ahead fetches matching grid images, hero art, logos, and icons for every game it imports.

steamGridDb.title: Browse custom artwork on SteamGridDB
steamGridDb.description: Browse SteamGridDB's full library for every game and swap in the artwork you actually want.

review.title: Review before you apply anything
review.description: See every Steam entry and launcher link that's about to be added or updated before you apply anything.

done.title: All done, with an automatic backup
done.description: Changes are applied and a backup of your Steam config is created automatically, so you can always roll back.

customization.title: Make it feel like yours
customization.description: Choose your language and switch between light, dark, or system color scheme, right from the settings.

steamSettings.title: Decide how Steam gets handled
steamSettings.description: Decide whether Steam is closed and restarted automatically, group imports into per-launcher collections, and override the install location if it isn't auto-detected.

sources.title: Configure sources
sources.description: Enable or disable each launcher, and override its auto-detected install path if Full Steam Ahead can't find it on its own.

artworkSource.title: Choose where your artwork comes from
artworkSource.description: Choose which source artwork is fetched from automatically, Steam or SteamGridDB, then enable SteamGridDB browsing and add your own API key.

backups.title: Every backup, one restore away
backups.description: Browse every automatic backup Full Steam Ahead has made, restore any of them, or clean up the ones you don't need.
